channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs starting Sept. 8 after U.S. imposes duties
item.description: The U.S. placed 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods. Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will match these tariffs dollar-for-dollar.

item.title: As Flock faces scrutiny, other police surveillance firms see opportunity
item.description: Dozens of cities have ended contracts with Flock. Some switch to competitors, but privacy experts say these alternatives offer no real improvement.

item.title: Opinion: Mr. Rogers finds a new neighborhood
item.description: MLB catcher Jake Rogers has faced uncertainty recently, moving between the Tigers, Orioles, and Red Sox.

item.title: DeepMind alumni-founded Inherent says its AI 'teammate' outperformed rivals in replicating research
item.description: British AI lab Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, released Faraday, an AI agent that can replicate scientific papers, potentially advancing research.
